title: command palette custom shortcut is not working

judgment.rationale: The report says custom Alt+Space does not open Command Palette while Shift+Space works. It does not say whether Windows opens the foreground window’s system menu or whether the shortcut is saved, so an OS/application chord conflict cannot yet be distinguished from CmdPal registration failure.
evidence: Reporter says Alt+Space fails and Shift+Space works.
No comments or linked fixes are present.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask what receives Alt+Space and whether the setting persists on current release.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report does not establish whether the OS/application consumes Alt+Space or CmdPal hotkey registration fails; do not propose a registration change before checking observed behavior.

issue_context.summary: A custom Alt+Space shortcut did not open Command Palette while Shift+Space did.
known_information: App runs non-elevated and report supplies OS/.NET details.
No diagnostic or reproduction video is attached.
inferences: A Windows or foreground-app system-menu binding may intercept Alt+Space, but that is not observed in the report.
issue_context.analysis: Determine which window receives the chord before changing shortcut handling.
initial_investigation: Read issue body and lack of follow-up.
Inspected pinned CmdPal source tree; no specific hotkey-registration failure was established from issue metadata alone.

information_gaps.information: Whether Alt+Space opens the active window’s system menu or produces no response, and whether Command Palette still opens with another global chord after saving the custom shortcut.
information_gaps.why_needed: Alt+Space can be consumed by Windows or an application as a window-management chord. Report says Shift+Space works but does not say which component receives the failing chord or whether configuration persists.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Save Alt+Space in Command Palette settings, press it while a normal application is foreground, and report what appears; then test saved working Shift+Space chord and include current PowerToys version.

comment.body: Thanks for noting that Shift+Space works. Could you save Alt+Space on the current release and press it while a normal app is active: does the app’s system menu open, or is there no response? Please also confirm whether the saved Shift+Space chord still opens Command Palette. This will distinguish an OS/application shortcut conflict from a Command Palette registration problem.
